g.text: TrendDetective (main @ a6e430f) — Feature gaps between the work areas
Area is reduced to its centre point; ④ can only fetch one coordinate and one station. No data "for an area".
④ area / multi-station fetch, ③ aggregate
At Aachen 2020, 24 of 44 topics fail: no station within 2°, all marine_* get HTTP 400. ② still offers them.
Dates "YYYY-MM" / "YYYY" fail to parse in _bin_records → 0 values, empty chart.
One request for the whole range; hourly and marine datasets over long ranges time out.
tmax, tavg, tmin (or speed + direction) are averaged into one series; no way to pick a variable.
② require area or ③ error
Mann-Kendall only appears in the map popup; unavailable t-Test shows "undefined".
Implemented and tested, but process_user_request never calls it.
Chart has no dates on the x-axis and no unit on the y-axis.
One feature per topic on the same shape: only the top one is visible; colour = slope sign only.
bbox centre averaged naively: 170° and -170° give 0°.
get_all_topics_list returns keys only; the UI shows "wet_bulb_temperature".
do_POST catches only ValueError / AssertionError; anything else drops the reply and the page shows a generic message.
provider="noaa" is hard-coded; no other source selectable.
Arrows point from the area that offers a feature to the area that cannot use or deliver it.
